query: How do I adjust a bifold door?

goal.title: Adjust a bifold closet door's hinge so it closes flush
goal.description: Runs a hand along a wooden bifold closet door to check its fit in the frame, then crouches repeatedly at the bottom hinge to turn its screw with a screwdriver. Swings the door open and closed between adjustments to test whether it now closes flush, pausing once to move a basket aside on a nearby desk, before a final extended adjustment while holding the door steady.
goal.final_state: The bifold door hangs flush and closed in its frame at the end of the clip, after repeated hinge-screw adjustments and swing tests.
procedure: Feel along the bifold door edge and inspect its fit.
Work at the bottom hinge, briefly moving a basket aside.
Swing the door open and closed to test the fit.
Return to the lower hinge, make further adjustments, and test the door again.

phases.description: Inspect the door and crouch at the bottom hinge to turn its screw.
Open and close the door to test whether the hinge fix worked.
Continue adjusting the hinge and testing the door until it closes flush.
